slides.dek: This bird has walked into traffic on purpose every day of its life and never once felt doubt.

slides.h: WALK LIKE YOU OWN THE STREET
slides.body: The pigeon crosses a four-lane road at walking speed. The cars stop. The pigeon does not. Speed is doubt.
The pigeon attends weddings, funerals, food courts, and the heads of national statues. It was invited to none of them. Neither were you. Go anyway.
The pigeon eats one crumb in front of 200 commuters while maintaining eye contact with all of them. That is the energy.
The pigeon has been shooed away 4,000 times. It has returned 4,001 times. It does not remember your no.
The pigeon does not replay conversations from 2019 at 3am. That is the entire secret. Class dismissed.
Send this to the friend who apologizes to furniture.
